checks.title: Identifier collisions within a locus project fail generation, naming both section ids
Every Cs*Ref string resolves to a generated declaration
A missing designated name field / headline fails, naming the section
A missing authored key (message key, error code, setting key, operation name, route id) fails
A form-3 body with an empty SOM description fails
No generated body returns a fabricated value — a 3b return is admissible only where the returned value came out of a collaborator or substrate call
@CodeSpec sits on the emission unit and its section ids equal its @DocSpec set
Only the slots of a marker's declared kind are non-null (@CsTrigger, @CsAuthorize, @CsJob)
Every mirrored enum matches its tom_core counterpart value-for-value
@CsText with role == error has category == errorCopy
The shared → {client, server} dependency arrow is never inverted
A server handler's operation string equals its shared CsOperationRef
Cumulative CE-MG DDL converges on the @CsTable / @CsColumn model
@CsValidation never emits the non-declarable compose token
overridableBy names a scope strictly narrower than the marker's own
A @CsServerConfig(secret: true) member has no initialiser
Every TomNotificationChannelDeclaration.fallbackChannelId resolves to a channel declared in the same catalogue
Every TomReportColumn.drillThroughRouteId resolves to a CE-NV route declared in the client project
A @CsServerConfig(secret: true) member keys a declared setting
Two @CsServerConfig members claiming the same setting key fail, naming both section ids
A CsGradedAccess slot's @CsAuthorize is never itself graded — the graded depth is exactly one level
A @CsColumn member is a plain Dart field, never a TomN*/observable — an observable column reads but cannot be written
Every collaborator call in a form-3b body resolves to a method of the declaration's own @CsCollaborator class, and every collaborator method is called by at least one body of its owning declaration
A @CsCollaborator class is abstract, declares only abstract methods, and has no field, constructor or static member
Every method of a form-3a or form-3b declaration, and every method of a @CsCollaborator class, carries a doc comment
No generated file holds a non-documentation comment other than §2.7's three-line banner
A doc comment carries no trailing whitespace, sits immediately above the first annotation with no blank line, and escapes `[`, `]` and `<` outside fenced code blocks
A form-3b body contains only the five §2.4 statement kinds, its local bindings are final and initialised from a call, and it binds no collaborator result
Every branch in a generated body is an `if` on a collaborator guard call, never a composed expression, and no body repeats or selects multi-way
A collaborator method repeats its calling body's parameters name-for-name and type-for-type, and its return type follows the call's position
Regenerating over an unchanged model reproduces the trio byte-for-byte
Every doc-comment line occurs in the extract of a section the declaration traces to — a line that occurs nowhere is composed prose
A grouped holder — a top-level declaration with no `@DocSpec` — carries C3's one-line template and no other generated prose
A doc-comment line is its source line entire — not a re-wrap of it, and not a value the comment stopped rendering part-way
Every token the extracts hold a value for is cited by a back-link in the trio — an uncited token is a specification fact that reached no code
Every token a back-link names exists in the extracts — a trace to a token no area routed is stale or invented
A member reflection writes — a @CsColumn attribute, a CE-API DTO field — is late and never final, because reflection assigns through a setter a final field does not have
